title: It's still ok to enjoy programming
why_read: A reflective essay on the joy of programming amid AI-driven anxiety, popular for its discussion value more than technical novelty.
analysis: This is an opinion piece responding to the current narrative that AI will replace programmers, arguing that coding as a craft retains value. It's not a technical deep-dive but a cultural/industry commentary piece that generated heavy discussion given 385 comments. Useful for gauging community sentiment rather than learning something new technically.
